title: Bernoulli gripper apparatus having at least one bernoulli gripper

features.item: A housing with a grip portion for gripping and an electrically operated vacuum generating device
features.note: The reference describes a Bernoulli gripper apparatus that uses compressed air to generate negative pressure, not an electrically operated vacuum generating device.

features.item: The grip portion is a hollow body
features.note: The reference describes a gripper body and a funnel-shaped component with an extraction duct, but not a hollow grip portion.

features.item: Exhaust air from the vacuum generating device is guided through the grip portion to an air outlet
features.note: The reference describes exhaust air being guided through an extraction duct within the Bernoulli gripper, not through a grip portion.

features.item: A sound-damping device is arranged in the grip portion
features.note: The reference describes a damping device for the wafer, not a sound-damping device in a grip portion.

features.item: A grip unit with hollow grip portion, electrically operated vacuum generator, exhaust air routed through grip to outlet, and sound-damping device in grip portion
features.note: The reference describes a Bernoulli gripper apparatus that uses compressed air and an extraction duct, not an electrically operated vacuum generator with a hollow grip portion and sound damping.

features.item: A vacuum handling apparatus comprising a suction plate with carrier plate and seal, and a grip unit with hollow grip portion, electrically operated vacuum generator, exhaust air routed through grip to outlet, and sound-damping device
features.note: The reference describes a Bernoulli gripper apparatus that uses compressed air to generate negative pressure for suctioning wafers, not an electrically operated vacuum generator with a hollow grip portion and sound damping.

features.item: The grip portion is at least partially lined with sound-damping material
features.note: The reference does not mention a grip portion or sound-damping material lining any part of the gripper.

features.item: The vacuum generating device is arranged completely in a first housing portion
features.note: The reference describes a flow system for compressed air, not an electrically operated vacuum generating device arranged in a housing portion.

features.item: A sound-reducing device is arranged in the first housing portion or the first housing portion is lined with sound-reducing material
features.note: The reference does not describe a sound-reducing device or lining in any housing portion.

features.item: The grip portion is elongated between the first housing portion and a second housing portion, with air outlet on the second housing portion
features.note: The reference describes a gripper body and an extraction duct, but not an elongated grip portion between housing portions with an air outlet.

features.item: An air collection screw arranged upstream of the grip portion in the first housing portion for collecting exhaust air
features.note: The reference does not mention an air collection screw or a grip portion.

features.item: Bent or curved air baffles downstream of the grip portion for guiding exhaust air to the air outlet
features.note: The reference describes an extraction duct for guiding exhaust air, but not bent or curved air baffles downstream of a grip portion.

features.item: A battery coupling point on the second housing portion with air baffles directing exhaust air away from the battery coupling point
features.note: The reference does not mention a battery coupling point or air baffles directing exhaust air away from it.

features.item: The grip unit and suction plate are releasably connected via a coupling device
features.note: The reference describes a Bernoulli gripper apparatus for receiving planar substrates, but not a releasably connected grip unit and suction plate.

features.item: The grip unit has a suction opening fluidically connected to a suction chamber delimited by the suction plate
features.note: The reference describes a Bernoulli gripper that generates negative pressure at a gripping surface, but not a grip unit with a suction opening connected to a suction chamber delimited by a suction plate.

claims.note: This reference describes a Bernoulli gripper apparatus for planar substrates, not a grip unit for a vacuum hand-operated laying device with a suction plate.
This reference describes a gripper body connected to a robotic arm, not a housing with a grip portion for a hand-operated device or an electrically operated vacuum generating device.
This reference does not describe a grip portion designed as a hollow body.

(non-English passage at claim 1) The reference teaches that air is guided upwards and outwards from the Bernoulli gripper, but it is compressed air used to generate negative pressure, not exhaust air from a vacuum generating device, and it is not guided through a grip portion.
The reference describes a damping device for the wafer, not a sound-damping device in the grip portion for exhaust air.
The reference does not mention the grip portion being lined with a sound-damping material.
The reference describes a Bernoulli gripper apparatus and does not mention a vacuum generating device arranged completely in a first housing portion.
The reference does not mention a sound-reducing device in a first housing portion or the first housing portion being lined with sound-reducing material.

The reference describes a Bernoulli gripper with a rectangular or circular outline, but does not explicitly mention a grip portion elongated between a first and second housing portion with an air outlet arranged on the second housing portion.

The reference describes an extraction duct for exhaust air but does not mention an air collection device in the form of an air collection screw arranged upstream of the grip portion for collecting exhaust air before it passes to the grip portion.

(non-English passage at paragraph 0055) The reference describes guiding exhaust air using a convex surface and into an extraction duct, which can be considered a form of air baffle, but it does not explicitly mention bent or curved air baffles downstream of the grip portion in a second housing portion.

The reference does not mention a battery coupling point for an electrical energy storage device or rechargeable battery, nor does it describe air baffles specifically for directing exhaust air away from such a point.

The reference describes directing exhaust air inwards and upwards through an extraction duct, but does not mention air baffles specifically for directing exhaust air away from a battery coupling point.
(non-English passage at claim 1) The reference describes a Bernoulli gripper apparatus for handling planar substrates, which is a type of vacuum handling apparatus.
The reference describes support elements with gripping surfaces, but not a suction plate comprising a carrier plate and a seal fastened to and extending around it.
(non-English passage at claim 1) The reference describes a Bernoulli gripper apparatus, which is a type of grip unit, but the claim references 'claim 1' which is not provided in the context.
The reference describes a Bernoulli gripper apparatus, not a vacuum handling apparatus with a releasably connected grip unit and suction plate via a coupling device.

(non-English passage at claim 1) The reference discloses generating a negative pressure (vacuum) at the gripping surface to suction a wafer, but it does not explicitly mention a 'suction opening' or a 'suction chamber delimited by the suction plate' as a specific mechanism for generating this vacuum.

overall.why: The reference describes a Bernoulli gripper for handling wafers, which is a type of vacuum handling apparatus. However, it uses compressed air to generate suction and does not disclose an electrically operated vacuum generator, a hollow grip portion for exhaust air routing, or sound-damping features
